title: Normalized finite localization coefficient coherence
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l in an arbitrary universe, a finite-field datum D with l different from its characteristic, and complementary closed/open immersions i:Z→X and j:U→X over D.k, with X separated of finite type. Use the actual raw rational finite stages and normalized scalar transitions [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], compact-support coefficient action [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action], and finite rational localization packages [def-sf-rational-localization-data], with the geometry of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. There exist simultaneous finite localization packages and four coefficient-compatible stage-system morphisms for j_!, i_*, j^*, i^*. At every finite field they equal the prescribed finite functors; the two pullback beta components are the canonical pullback comparisons and the closed pushforward beta is the mate of inverse closed-pullback beta. The four finite shifts, additive and triangulated structures are those of the finite localization packages. Beta commutes with these shifts and obeys the normalized scalar-unit equation. The finite open/closed adjunctions equal the package adjunctions and commute with the prescribed shifts. Their units and counits form compatible StageSystem.Morphism.Hom families with the indicated finite components. No descended exactness, adjunction, triangle, or Hom-colimit conclusion is asserted. The finite records are those of [def-sf-qbar-localization-finite-data].
